pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against adding to positions unless the primary trade has achieved at least +$10.00 in floating profit and volatility contraction is confirmed.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require confirmed multi-timeframe volume delta divergence and a 14-period ATR volatility expansion filter prior to order dispatch.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate trailing profit locks at +$10.00 and allow winners to scale freely up to +$30.00 via dynamic ATR trailing stops.
